title: Savory Algerian Sausage Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African-inspired dish made with tender sausage, crispy vegetables, and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Tagine
ingredients.notes: with a heavy bottom for slow cooking

instructions: 1. Heat oil in the tagine over medium heat.
2. Add the Algerian sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the tra and crisp, cook for another 5 minutes, until the vegetables start to soften.
4. Add the nutty and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven.
7. Cook at 300°F (150°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until the sausages are cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
